spanish: Y a lado de norte, cien en codo; sus columnas veinte, y sus basas veinte bronce; ganchos de las columnas y sus bandas plata.
grammarChanges: Translated צָפוֹן (H6828, feminine singular absolute) as the common noun 'norte' instead of leaving it as the untranslated proper name 'Tsafón'.
Removed the unwarranted definite article from 'al lado' (construct noun פְּאַת takes no article) → 'a lado'.
Removed the unwarranted definite article from 'en el codo' (absolute noun אַמָּה) → 'en codo'.
Removed the inserted 'de' before the bare material nouns נְחֹשֶׁת and כָּסֶף (grammatical smoothing not present in the source) → 'veinte bronce' and 'bandas plata'.
